event.title: María Machado returned to Venezuela after more than 10 months in exile
event.canonical_title: María Machado returned to Venezuela after more than 10 months in exile
event.summary: María Corina Machado, a prominent opposition leader and Nobel Peace Prize winner, has returned to Venezuela after nearly a year in exile. She left the country in December 2025 to accept the Nobel Prize in Norway and has since conducted her political activities from abroad. Upon her return to Caracas, she was welcomed by thousands of supporters amid ongoing demands for elections in Venezuela.

timeline.title: María Machado returned to Venezuela after more than 10 months in exile
timeline.summary: María Machado, a prominent Venezuelan opposition leader, has returned to Venezuela after spending over 10 months in exile. She left the country shortly before the US military intervention that led to the ousting of Nicolás Maduro. Her return comes amid ongoing concerns regarding the state of democracy in Venezuela.
key_facts: María Machado returned to Venezuela after more than 10 months in exile.
She left the country just before the US military intervention that deposed Nicolás Maduro.
Concerns about democracy in Venezuela are deepening.
